# Retail sales dropped sharply in July as consumers tighten spending

Retail sales fell 0.6% in July, a bigger drop than expected and a sharp reversal from June's modest uptick.

Retailby Mitchell Hartman

A modest increase in sales was expected. But now, the declining numbers could continue into August as consumer sentiment sours.

Frederic J. Brown/AFP via Getty Images
